ai_summary: The Supreme Court has allowed a forensic audit of Fortis Healthcare Limited to proceed, while significantly clarifying that earlier adverse observations by the Delhi High Court are 'tentative' and will not influence the audit's independent findings. This outcome, while permitting the audit, mitigates immediate reputational concerns by preventing prejudgment, with Fortis reaffirming no liability has been imposed and emphasizing its separation from past issues involving former promoters since its 2018 management change.
